title: A Healthy Day for Kids! Play, Sunscreen and More with Kiko
intro: Hi, friends! I'm Pip the strawberry, and this is my buddy Kiko the broccoli!
Welcome to Fruity Friends! Today we're learning five habits for a happy, healthy day.
Can you count with me? One, two, three, four, five!
Yummy food and healthy habits help us grow, play and learn every day.
Ready? Let's go to the kitchen and find out!

lines: Here's a clue: we run, jump, dance and have fun with our bodies! Can you guess?
This is moving and playing! Can you say play?
Moving your body makes your heart pump and your muscles strong.
You can run, jump, dance, climb, or play catch with a ball!
Let's move! Jump, jump, jump! Now spin around! Now freeze!
How often should we move and play?
Every day! Little kids love to move a lot.
One more time, nice and loud: PLAY!
After playing, drink some water and take a rest.
Here's a clue: it's a cream we put on our skin before we play in the sun! Can you guess?
This is Sunscreen! Can you say sunscreen?
Sunscreen helps protect your skin from the strong sunshine.
A grown-up helps put it on before you go outside.
Can you pretend to rub on sunscreen? Nose, cheeks, arms and legs!
What else helps us in the sun?
A hat, sunglasses, and playing in the shade!
One more time, nice and loud: SUNSCREEN!
After swimming, a grown-up puts on a little more sunscreen.
Here's a clue: ah, ah, ah-choo! Where should that sneeze go? Can you guess?
This is covering your sneeze! Can you say elbow?
When you sneeze or cough, cover it with your elbow or a tissue.
That keeps germs from flying to your friends.
Can you do a pretend sneeze into your elbow? Ah, ah, ah-choo!
What do we do after we use a tissue?
Throw it away, and wash your hands!
One more time, nice and loud: ELBOW!
Covering your sneeze is a kind way to help your friends stay well.
Here's a clue: it's clear and cool, and it's the best drink when you're thirsty! Can you guess?
This is drinking water! Can you say water?
Water helps your whole body work, from your head to your toes.
When you run and play, you get thirsty. That's your body asking for water!
Can you take a pretend sip? Glug, glug, glug! Ahh!
When we're thirsty, at mealtime, and after we play!
One more time, nice and loud: WATER!
A water bottle you can fill again is great to take along.
Here's a clue: we put on pajamas, close our eyes, and dream! Can you guess?
This is Bedtime! Can you say bedtime?
Sleep helps your body grow and rest.
Little kids need lots of sleep, even more than grown-ups!
Can you do a big pretend yawn and stretch? Yaaawn!
What helps us get ready for bed?
A bath, brushing teeth, a story, and a cozy, quiet room.
One more time, nice and loud: BEDTIME!
A good sleep helps you wake up ready to play.

recap: Yummy! Let's remember what we learned.
outro: Which one was your favorite? Tell a grown-up, and try something new this week!
Bye, friends! See you next time on Fruity Friends!
